fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of Chromium based browser in headless mode
fields.name: Browser Execution In Headless Mode
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\brave.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\chrome.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\msedge.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\opera.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\vivaldi.exe") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--headless"))
